caption: "madonna" — 1,000,000+ searches this week. She opened the VMAs for a record 5th time.

Why: Madonna opened the MTV VMAs in Los Angeles on September 27, her first VMAs performance in 23 years, with Sabrina Carpenter and Charli XCX. Then she won 7 awards, including Artist of the Year. At 68, she is the oldest winner of that award.

What most people don't know: the first VMAs, in 1984, opened with her too. She came down a 17-foot wedding cake singing "Like a Virgin." Backstage, she says, her manager told her that her career was over.
Very simply put: 42 years later, the career that was over won Artist of the Year.
